t: This is Lindsey House, a Grade II star listed villa on Cheyne Walk in Chelsea. It's owned by the National Trust, but it has tenants and is open only by special arrangement, so you'll be admiring it from the street. It was commissioned by Robert Bertie, the third Earl of Lindsey, an English nobleman who lived from 1630 to 1701. He was styled Lord Willoughby de Eresby from 1642 to 1666, and he was a Fellow of the Royal Society. His name is the one the house still carries.
